---
title: "Explore a random forest"
toc: false
page-layout: full
---

This explorer uses two ensembles trained on the gas-turbine positive-label
task. Both contain 200 fully grown trees fitted to bootstrap samples. The
random forest also draws three of the nine operating features as candidates at
each split.

::: {.callout-tip}
## What to watch

Start with one tree, then add more. Individual tree votes can disagree,
especially for the borderline operating observation. Their average becomes the
ensemble's positive-label probability. Switch between bagging and random
forest to see how random feature competition produces a more varied collection
of root splits.
:::

```{=html}
<div id="random-forest-explorer" class="rf-explorer" aria-label="Interactive explorer for bagging and random forests">
  <div class="rf-controls" aria-label="Random-forest explorer controls">
    <label>
      <span>Ensemble method</span>
      <select id="rf-model-select">
        <option value="bagging">Bagging</option>
        <option value="randomForest" selected>Random forest</option>
      </select>
    </label>

    <label>
      <span>Held-out operating observation</span>
      <select id="rf-observation-select"></select>
    </label>

    <label class="rf-tree-slider">
      <span>Included trees</span>
      <input id="rf-tree-slider" type="range" min="1" value="1">
      <output id="rf-tree-count" for="rf-tree-slider">1</output>
    </label>
  </div>

  <div class="clt-buttons" aria-label="Forest-growth controls">
    <button id="rf-next-tree" type="button" class="regression-sampling-primary">Add next tree</button>
    <button id="rf-run-all" type="button">Run all trees</button>
    <button id="rf-reset" type="button">Reset</button>
  </div>

  <p id="rf-status" class="clt-status tabular-nums" aria-live="polite"></p>

  <section id="rf-observation-card" class="rf-observation-card" aria-label="Selected operating observation"></section>

  <div class="rf-plots">
    <figure class="rf-plot">
      <figcaption>Individual tree votes and their running average</figcaption>
      <svg id="rf-vote-chart" role="img" aria-label="Individual tree votes for the selected observation and their running average"></svg>
    </figure>

    <figure class="rf-plot">
      <figcaption>Held-out ROC AUC as the forest grows</figcaption>
      <svg id="rf-auc-chart" role="img" aria-label="Held-out ROC AUC as trees are added to bagging and random-forest ensembles"></svg>
    </figure>
  </div>

  <figure class="rf-root-figure">
    <figcaption>Root features among the trees included so far</figcaption>
    <svg id="rf-root-chart" role="img" aria-label="Root-split feature counts for the currently included trees"></svg>
  </figure>
</div>

The curves and votes are precomputed from the same gas-turbine data used in
the accompanying notebook. The page reveals an existing fitted ensemble; it
does not refit trees in the browser.

[Return to Tree-based](index.qmd)

<script src="../assets/random-forest-explorer.js"></script>
<script>
(() => {
  const root = document.getElementById("random-forest-explorer");
  const explorer = window.MECE4520RandomForestExplorer;
  if (!root || !explorer) return;

  const modelSelect = root.querySelector("#rf-model-select");
  const observationSelect = root.querySelector("#rf-observation-select");
  const treeSlider = root.querySelector("#rf-tree-slider");
  const treeCountOutput = root.querySelector("#rf-tree-count");
  const nextButton = root.querySelector("#rf-next-tree");
  const runButton = root.querySelector("#rf-run-all");
  const resetButton = root.querySelector("#rf-reset");
  const status = root.querySelector("#rf-status");
  const observationCard = root.querySelector("#rf-observation-card");
  const voteChart = root.querySelector("#rf-vote-chart");
  const aucChart = root.querySelector("#rf-auc-chart");
  const rootChart = root.querySelector("#rf-root-chart");

  if (
    !modelSelect || !observationSelect || !treeSlider
    || !treeCountOutput || !nextButton || !runButton || !resetButton
    || !status || !observationCard || !voteChart || !aucChart || !rootChart
  ) return;

  const colors = {
    bagging: "#d77732",
    randomForest: "#457eaa",
    positive: "#d9534f",
    negative: "#4c8f70",
    inactive: "#e7edf0",
    grid: "#d8e1e5",
    axis: "#5d6a72",
    text: "#34454d",
    other: "#9aa8ae",
    threshold: "#555555"
  };

  const nTrees = explorer.metadata.nTrees;
  const modelKeys = ["bagging", "randomForest"];
  const rootOrder = (() => {
    const counts = {};
    modelKeys.forEach((modelKey) => {
      explorer.models[modelKey].roots.forEach((feature) => {
        counts[feature] = (counts[feature] || 0) + 1;
      });
    });
    return Object.keys(counts).sort((a, b) => counts[b] - counts[a]);
  })();

  let modelKey = "randomForest";
  let observationIndex = 1;
  let includedTrees = 1;
  let isRunning = false;
  let animationFrame = null;
  let lastFrameTime = 0;

  explorer.observations.forEach((observation, index) => {
    const option = document.createElement("option");
    option.value = String(index);
    option.textContent = observation.name;
    observationSelect.append(option);
  });
  observationSelect.value = String(observationIndex);
  treeSlider.max = String(nTrees);

  function svgElement(name, attributes = {}) {
    const element = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", name);
    Object.entries(attributes).forEach(([key, value]) => {
      element.setAttribute(key, value);
    });
    return element;
  }

  function addText(svg, text, x, y, attributes = {}) {
    const element = svgElement("text", Object.assign({ x: x, y: y }, attributes));
    element.textContent = text;
    svg.append(element);
    return element;
  }

  function appendTitleAndDescription(svg, titleText, descriptionText) {
    const title = svgElement("title", { id: svg.id + "-title" });
    const description = svgElement("desc", { id: svg.id + "-description" });
    title.textContent = titleText;
    description.textContent = descriptionText;
    svg.append(title, description);
    svg.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", title.id + " " + description.id);
  }

  function scale(value, domain, range) {
    return range[0] + ((value - domain[0]) / (domain[1] - domain[0])) * (range[1] - range[0]);
  }

  function currentModel() {
    return explorer.models[modelKey];
  }

  function currentObservation() {
    return explorer.observations[observationIndex];
  }

  function otherModelKey() {
    return modelKey === "bagging" ? "randomForest" : "bagging";
  }

  function runningProbability(probabilities) {
    return probabilities.slice(0, includedTrees).reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / includedTrees;
  }

  function rootCounts() {
    const counts = {};
    currentModel().roots.slice(0, includedTrees).forEach((feature) => {
      counts[feature] = (counts[feature] || 0) + 1;
    });
    return counts;
  }

  function drawObservationCard() {
    const observation = currentObservation();
    const features = observation.features;
    observationCard.replaceChildren();

    const heading = document.createElement("h2");
    heading.textContent = observation.name + " operating observation";
    observationCard.append(heading);

    const description = document.createElement("p");
    description.textContent = observation.actualLabel === 1
      ? "Observed label: positive (1)"
      : "Observed label: negative (0)";
    observationCard.append(description);

    const details = document.createElement("dl");
    Object.entries(features).forEach(([feature, value]) => {
      const term = document.createElement("dt");
      term.textContent = feature;
      const definition = document.createElement("dd");
      definition.textContent = Number(value).toFixed(2);
      details.append(term, definition);
    });
    observationCard.append(details);
  }

  function drawVoteChart() {
    const observation = currentObservation();
    const probabilities = observation.models[modelKey].treeProbabilities;
    const width = 680;
    const height = 395;
    const margin = { top: 34, right: 34, bottom: 83, left: 66 };
    const plotRight = width - margin.right;
    const plotBottom = height - margin.bottom;
    const gridColumns = 20;
    const gridRows = Math.ceil(nTrees / gridColumns);
    const cellWidth = (plotRight - margin.left) / gridColumns;
    const cellHeight = 15;
    const tileAreaTop = margin.top + 16;
    const gaugeTop = tileAreaTop + gridRows * cellHeight + 44;
    const gaugeWidth = plotRight - margin.left;
    const probability = runningProbability(probabilities);

    voteChart.replaceChildren();
    voteChart.setAttribute("viewBox", "0 0 " + width + " " + height);
    voteChart.setAttribute("preserveAspectRatio", "xMidYMid meet");
    appendTitleAndDescription(
      voteChart,
      "Tree votes and running average",
      includedTrees + " tree votes are shown for the selected held-out observation. Their average is " + probability.toFixed(3) + "."
    );

    addText(voteChart, "Tree votes: positive = red; negative = green", margin.left, margin.top, {
      class: "rf-chart-note"
    });

    for (let index = 0; index < nTrees; index += 1) {
      const column = index % gridColumns;
      const row = Math.floor(index / gridColumns);
      const active = index < includedTrees;
      const fill = active
        ? (probabilities[index] >= 0.5 ? colors.positive : colors.negative)
        : colors.inactive;
      voteChart.append(svgElement("rect", {
        x: margin.left + column * cellWidth + 1,
        y: tileAreaTop + row * cellHeight + 1,
        width: Math.max(1, cellWidth - 2),
        height: cellHeight - 2,
        rx: 2,
        class: active ? "rf-vote-tile rf-vote-active" : "rf-vote-tile",
        fill: fill
      }));
    }

    addText(voteChart, "1", margin.left, tileAreaTop + gridRows * cellHeight + 17, {
      class: "rf-chart-tick",
      "text-anchor": "start"
    });
    addText(voteChart, String(nTrees), plotRight, tileAreaTop + gridRows * cellHeight + 17, {
      class: "rf-chart-tick",
      "text-anchor": "end"
    });
    addText(voteChart, "Tree number", (margin.left + plotRight) / 2, tileAreaTop + gridRows * cellHeight + 17, {
      class: "rf-chart-tick",
      "text-anchor": "middle"
    });

    voteChart.append(svgElement("rect", {
      x: margin.left,
      y: gaugeTop,
      width: gaugeWidth,
      height: 20,
      rx: 10,
      class: "rf-gauge-background"
    }));
    voteChart.append(svgElement("rect", {
      x: margin.left,
      y: gaugeTop,
      width: Math.max(1, gaugeWidth * probability),
      height: 20,
      rx: 10,
      class: "rf-gauge-fill",
      fill: colors[modelKey]
    }));
    const thresholdX = margin.left + gaugeWidth * 0.5;
    voteChart.append(svgElement("line", {
      x1: thresholdX,
      y1: gaugeTop - 6,
      x2: thresholdX,
      y2: gaugeTop + 27,
      class: "rf-threshold-line",
      stroke: colors.threshold
    }));
    addText(voteChart, "0", margin.left, gaugeTop + 46, {
      class: "rf-chart-tick",
      "text-anchor": "start"
    });
    addText(voteChart, "0.5", thresholdX, gaugeTop + 46, {
      class: "rf-chart-tick",
      "text-anchor": "middle"
    });
    addText(voteChart, "1", plotRight, gaugeTop + 46, {
      class: "rf-chart-tick",
      "text-anchor": "end"
    });
    addText(voteChart, "Running positive-label probability = " + probability.toFixed(3), margin.left, gaugeTop - 10, {
      class: "rf-chart-value"
    });
    addText(voteChart, "0.5 decision threshold", thresholdX, gaugeTop + 66, {
      class: "rf-chart-tick",
      "text-anchor": "middle"
    });
  }

  function pathFromValues(values, x, y, limit) {
    return values.slice(0, limit).map((value, index) => {
      return (index === 0 ? "M" : "L") + x(index + 1).toFixed(2) + " " + y(value).toFixed(2);
    }).join(" ");
  }

  function drawAucChart() {
    const width = 560;
    const height = 395;
    const margin = { top: 34, right: 28, bottom: 60, left: 66 };
    const plotRight = width - margin.right;
    const plotBottom = height - margin.bottom;
    const current = currentModel();
    const other = explorer.models[otherModelKey()];
    const lower = 0.78;
    const upper = 0.97;
    const x = value => scale(value, [1, nTrees], [margin.left, plotRight]);
    const y = value => scale(value, [lower, upper], [plotBottom, margin.top]);
    const currentAuc = current.auc[includedTrees - 1];

    aucChart.replaceChildren();
    aucChart.setAttribute("viewBox", "0 0 " + width + " " + height);
    aucChart.setAttribute("preserveAspectRatio", "xMidYMid meet");
    appendTitleAndDescription(
      aucChart,
      "Held-out AUC as the forest grows",
      "The current " + current.label + " ensemble has held-out ROC AUC " + currentAuc.toFixed(3) + " after " + includedTrees + " trees."
    );

    [0.80, 0.85, 0.90, 0.95].forEach((tick) => {
      const yPosition = y(tick);
      aucChart.append(svgElement("line", {
        x1: margin.left,
        y1: yPosition,
        x2: plotRight,
        y2: yPosition,
        class: "rf-chart-grid"
      }));
      addText(aucChart, tick.toFixed(2), margin.left - 10, yPosition + 4, {
        class: "rf-chart-tick",
        "text-anchor": "end"
      });
    });
    [1, 50, 100, 150, 200].forEach((tick) => {
      const xPosition = x(tick);
      aucChart.append(svgElement("line", {
        x1: xPosition,
        y1: margin.top,
        x2: xPosition,
        y2: plotBottom,
        class: "rf-chart-grid"
      }));
      addText(aucChart, String(tick), xPosition, plotBottom + 20, {
        class: "rf-chart-tick",
        "text-anchor": "middle"
      });
    });

    aucChart.append(svgElement("line", {
      x1: margin.left,
      y1: plotBottom,
      x2: plotRight,
      y2: plotBottom,
      class: "rf-chart-axis"
    }));
    aucChart.append(svgElement("line", {
      x1: margin.left,
      y1: plotBottom,
      x2: margin.left,
      y2: margin.top,
      class: "rf-chart-axis"
    }));

    aucChart.append(svgElement("path", {
      d: pathFromValues(other.auc, x, y, nTrees),
      class: "rf-auc-other",
      stroke: colors.other
    }));
    aucChart.append(svgElement("path", {
      d: pathFromValues(current.auc, x, y, nTrees),
      class: "rf-auc-current",
      stroke: colors[modelKey]
    }));
    aucChart.append(svgElement("circle", {
      cx: x(includedTrees),
      cy: y(currentAuc),
      r: 5.5,
      class: "rf-auc-marker",
      fill: colors[modelKey]
    }));

    addText(aucChart, "Number of trees", (margin.left + plotRight) / 2, height - 11, {
      class: "rf-chart-axis-title",
      "text-anchor": "middle"
    });
    const yTitleX = 17;
    const yTitleY = (margin.top + plotBottom) / 2;
    addText(aucChart, "Held-out ROC AUC", yTitleX, yTitleY, {
      class: "rf-chart-axis-title",
      "text-anchor": "middle",
      transform: "rotate(-90 " + yTitleX + " " + yTitleY + ")"
    });
    addText(aucChart, current.label + ": " + currentAuc.toFixed(3), margin.left + 6, margin.top + 17, {
      class: "rf-chart-value",
      fill: colors[modelKey]
    });
    addText(aucChart, other.label + ": full curve for context", margin.left + 6, margin.top + 37, {
      class: "rf-chart-note"
    });
  }

  function drawRootChart() {
    const width = 1180;
    const height = 330;
    const margin = { top: 25, right: 24, bottom: 64, left: 66 };
    const plotRight = width - margin.right;
    const plotBottom = height - margin.bottom;
    const counts = rootCounts();
    const maximum = Math.max(1, ...rootOrder.map((feature) => counts[feature] || 0));
    const upper = Math.max(5, Math.ceil(maximum / 5) * 5);
    const slotWidth = (plotRight - margin.left) / rootOrder.length;
    const y = value => scale(value, [0, upper], [plotBottom, margin.top]);

    rootChart.replaceChildren();
    rootChart.setAttribute("viewBox", "0 0 " + width + " " + height);
    rootChart.setAttribute("preserveAspectRatio", "xMidYMid meet");
    appendTitleAndDescription(
      rootChart,
      "Root feature counts",
      "Among the first " + includedTrees + " trees, the most common root feature is " + rootOrder.reduce((best, feature) => (counts[feature] || 0) > (counts[best] || 0) ? feature : best, rootOrder[0]) + "."
    );

    [0, upper / 2, upper].forEach((tick) => {
      const yPosition = y(tick);
      rootChart.append(svgElement("line", {
        x1: margin.left,
        y1: yPosition,
        x2: plotRight,
        y2: yPosition,
        class: "rf-chart-grid"
      }));
      addText(rootChart, String(Math.round(tick)), margin.left - 10, yPosition + 4, {
        class: "rf-chart-tick",
        "text-anchor": "end"
      });
    });

    rootOrder.forEach((feature, index) => {
      const count = counts[feature] || 0;
      const barWidth = Math.min(70, slotWidth * 0.58);
      const xPosition = margin.left + index * slotWidth + (slotWidth - barWidth) / 2;
      const yPosition = y(count);
      rootChart.append(svgElement("rect", {
        x: xPosition,
        y: yPosition,
        width: barWidth,
        height: plotBottom - yPosition,
        rx: 3,
        class: "rf-root-bar",
        fill: colors[modelKey]
      }));
      addText(rootChart, String(count), xPosition + barWidth / 2, yPosition - 7, {
        class: "rf-chart-value",
        "text-anchor": "middle"
      });
      addText(rootChart, feature, xPosition + barWidth / 2, plotBottom + 20, {
        class: "rf-chart-tick",
        "text-anchor": "middle"
      });
    });

    rootChart.append(svgElement("line", {
      x1: margin.left,
      y1: plotBottom,
      x2: plotRight,
      y2: plotBottom,
      class: "rf-chart-axis"
    }));
    rootChart.append(svgElement("line", {
      x1: margin.left,
      y1: plotBottom,
      x2: margin.left,
      y2: margin.top,
      class: "rf-chart-axis"
    }));
    addText(rootChart, "Trees using the feature at the root", 18, (margin.top + plotBottom) / 2, {
      class: "rf-chart-axis-title",
      "text-anchor": "middle",
      transform: "rotate(-90 18 " + ((margin.top + plotBottom) / 2) + ")"
    });
  }

  function draw() {
    const observation = currentObservation();
    const model = currentModel();
    const probabilities = observation.models[modelKey].treeProbabilities;
    const probability = runningProbability(probabilities);
    const prediction = probability >= 0.5 ? 1 : 0;
    const currentAuc = model.auc[includedTrees - 1];
    const latestRoot = model.roots[includedTrees - 1];

    treeSlider.value = String(includedTrees);
    treeCountOutput.value = String(includedTrees);
    treeCountOutput.textContent = String(includedTrees);
    nextButton.disabled = includedTrees >= nTrees;
    runButton.disabled = includedTrees >= nTrees;

    status.textContent = model.label + " · " + includedTrees + " of " + nTrees
      + " trees · probability = " + probability.toFixed(3)
      + " · predicted label = " + prediction
      + " · observed label = " + observation.actualLabel
      + " · held-out AUC = " + currentAuc.toFixed(3)
      + " · newest root feature = " + latestRoot
      + " · full-forest mean tree-prediction correlation = " + model.meanPairwiseCorrelation.toFixed(3);

    drawObservationCard();
    drawVoteChart();
    drawAucChart();
    drawRootChart();
  }

  function update(nextCount) {
    includedTrees = Math.max(1, Math.min(nTrees, nextCount));
    draw();
  }

  function stopAnimation() {
    isRunning = false;
    if (animationFrame !== null) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
      animationFrame = null;
    }
  }

  function runAll(timestamp) {
    if (!isRunning) return;
    if (!lastFrameTime) lastFrameTime = timestamp;
    if (timestamp - lastFrameTime >= 38) {
      update(Math.min(nTrees, includedTrees + 3));
      lastFrameTime = timestamp;
    }
    if (includedTrees >= nTrees) {
      stopAnimation();
      return;
    }
    animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(runAll);
  }

  modelSelect.addEventListener("change", () => {
    stopAnimation();
    modelKey = modelSelect.value;
    update(includedTrees);
  });

  observationSelect.addEventListener("change", () => {
    stopAnimation();
    observationIndex = Number(observationSelect.value);
    update(includedTrees);
  });

  treeSlider.addEventListener("input", () => {
    stopAnimation();
    update(Number(treeSlider.value));
  });

  nextButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
    stopAnimation();
    update(includedTrees + 1);
  });

  runButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (includedTrees >= nTrees) return;
    stopAnimation();
    isRunning = true;
    lastFrameTime = 0;
    animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(runAll);
  });

  resetButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
    stopAnimation();
    update(1);
  });

  window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
    draw();
  });

  draw();
})();
</script>
```
